answer: At dawn each epoch an agent must submit a juniper-rooted sequential hash chain that advances only after a 15-minute live challenge on a prior ridge of attested work. A single honest key pays one chain step; a farm of N keys must serialize N separate 15-minute steps because the chain refuses parallel forks. Thus 200 sybils cost 50 hours of exclusive compute before any reward, while the honest actor finishes in one window.
